name: Higurashi: Path to Paradise
source:
Keiichi finds himself in Hinimizawa for a *quick* family trip as they try to sell off his deceased grandpa's house after putting it off for so long. Though as Keiichi is reunited with his childhood friends, inexplicable delusions begin ruining his vacation, turning it into a nightmare. Follow Keiichi as he pursues the paradise he once had in Hinimizawa as a child; will insanity get him there? 

[From [url=https://nepo07.itch.io/higurashi-path-to-paradise]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
为了卖掉已故外公搁置已久的老宅，圭一随家人踏上了一趟前往雏见泽的“短暂”家庭旅行。然而在与儿时伙伴重逢之后，难以理喻的妄想与幻觉开始毁掉他的假期，将其一步步变成一场噩梦。跟随圭一追寻他童年时代曾在雏见泽拥有过的乐园吧——疯狂真的能带他抵达彼岸吗？

[摘自[url=https://nepo07.itch.io/higurashi-path-to-paradise]itch.io[/url]]
